# select_ms_teams_alert_destination (Resource)

A Microsoft Teams channel that monitors send alerts to through an incoming webhook. It belongs to the organization's MS Teams webhook alert integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "select_alert_integration" "ms_teams" {
  integration_type = "ms_teams_webhook"
}

variable "teams_webhook_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "select_ms_teams_alert_destination" "finops" {
  integration_id = select_alert_integration.ms_teams.id
  channel        = "FinOps"
  webhook_url    = var.teams_webhook_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel` (String) The name of the Microsoft Teams channel, as SELECT shows it. The webhook URL, not this name, sets where alerts go.
- `integration_id` (String) The id of the alert integration this destination sends through. Its integration type must be the same as the destination's. Changing it forces a new destination.
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) The Microsoft Teams incoming webhook or workflow URL that alerts are posted to. SELECT never returns it, so Terraform cannot find a change made to it outside Terraform.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the destination was created — RFC 3339 UTC.
- `error_message` (String) Why the most recent delivery failed. Null unless status is `failing`.
- `etag` (String) Opaque strong ETag for this destination. Sent as `If-Match` on updates and deletes so a change made outside Terraform cannot be silently overwritten.
- `id` (String) The destination's identifier in SELECT. Use it with `terraform import`.
- `last_used_time` (String) When the destination last sent an alert or a test message — RFC 3339 UTC.
- `status` (String) The delivery status: `unknown` until the first delivery, then `connected` or `failing`, or `pending`.
- `update_time` (String) When the destination was last changed — RFC 3339 UTC.
- `webhook_url_update_time` (String) When webhook_url was last set — RFC 3339 UTC.
